more.title: Delta Air Lines hit with delays amid baggage network system issue
more.desc: The Delta Air Lines delays are most impacting flights in and out of Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport in Georgia. Delta Air Lines is facing a systemwide network issue involving its baggage system that is forcing teams to manually process bags, resulting in delays nationwide during a busy holiday travel weekend. A temporary ground delay program was issued at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport — Delta Air Lines' mega hub — to manage traffic backups because of the system outage. The ground delay, which has been lifted, impacted only Delta's flights. "Delta teams are using manual workarounds this morning to safely get flights departed while work continues to restore automation," the airline told CBS News on Sunday.

more.title: FAA lifts ground stop on Atlanta-bound Delta flights after system outage
more.desc: Delta Air Lines says crews are using manual workarounds after an outage in its weight-and-balance system reportedly delayed at least 3,500 flights. Passengers move inside Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, Friday, Nov. 7, 2025, in Atlanta. (AP Photo/Mike Stewart) A Sunday morning outage in Delta Air Lines' automated weight-and-balance system forced the Federal Aviation Administration to briefly halt Atlanta-bound flights and has reportedly delayed at least 3,500 Delta flights across major hubs, including Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport and New York's LaGuardia Airport. The technical failure rippled through Sunday's travel schedule, but the ground stop led to roughly an hour delay before being lifted .

more.title: FAA Says All Delta Flights Through Atlanta Delayed as Automated System Falters
more.desc: The system facing problems is used to calculate the weight and balance of departing flights. The disruptions come after a nationwide ground stop that canceled thousands of flights last weekend.

more.title: Delta tech issue delays Atlanta-bound flights ahead of Thanksgiving
more.desc: The FAA projected delays averaging nearly an hour for affected flights. Delta said it was using manual procedures to keep planes moving. A problem with the system Delta Air Lines uses to calculate aircraft weight and balance delayed flights into its Atlanta hub Sunday, as travelers headed out ahead of Thanksgiving. The Federal Aviation Administration briefly halted Atlanta-bound flights Sunday morning, then replaced the ground stop with a program that allowed flights to depart at staggered times. The delay program, requested by Delta, applied to the airline and its regional carriers flying into Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport from the contiguous United States.
